item.title: Trump says U.S. 'semi-negotiating' with Iran after Tehran sets new demands
item.description: President Trump indicated he would increase economic pressure on Iran as the stalemate persisted and Tehran introduced new conditions to resume talks.

item.title: Suge Knight speaks out ahead of Tupac Shakur murder suspect's trial
item.description: Suge Knight, who was driving the car when Tupac was shot in 1996, says he won't testify at the suspect's trial.

item.title: WATCH: Amanda Knox comedy show draws controversy
item.description: Amanda Knox responds to criticism from Kercher's sister that her Edinburgh Fringe comedy show trivializes the case.

item.title: Man who allegedly arranged Tupac Shakur's 1996 killing going on trial in Las Vegas
item.description: Duane 'Keffe D' Davis, accused of orchestrating the 1996 murder of Tupac Shakur, is set to stand trial nearly 30 years later.
